register: SEL ASCII (SEL-751 reference model) approved command register, Phase 0 draft
status: draft; A1 approved SHO G and SHO P 1 on 2026-10-23 (docs/agent-handoffs.md, commit 4481653 on claude/project-thread-hperik); A6 re-review pending
date: 2026-10-23 (revised after reading S22; re-cited to S22 table numbers; SHO G and SHO P 1 approved by A1)
sources: See docs/phase0/A2-device-feasibility.md section 1 (S1..S22). S22 = SEL-751 Instruction Manual, date code 20260910 (owner-supplied); page numbers below refer to it.
matching: Each pattern is a Python re.fullmatch against one received line. Allowed entries are exact canonical forms the adapter may send. Denied entries document known dangerous lines and are case-insensitive and abbreviation-tolerant on purpose. Any line matching no entry is a violation (deny by default).
not_representable_as_lines: The password line sent after ACC prompts 'Password:'. It must be logged by the simulator as an auth event, never as a command line, and never stored in clear.
Binary SEL Fast messages (0xA5 prefix, S10). Covered by sel.binary.any_non_ascii below only if the log decodes bytes as latin-1; the checker's CONTROL class misses 0x80-0xFF.
language: Valid only for LANG := ENGLISH on the port. With LANG := SPANISH command names differ and 'SER D' clears the SER (S22 Command Summary p.6). The adapter must confirm English before sending anything other than ID/ACC/QUI.

commands.citation: S22 Table 7.17 p.7.32; password behaviour p.7.33
commands.notes: Changes session access level only. One attempt per invocation (risk D2).
commands.side_effects: Changes session access level 0 to 1. Three wrong passwords pulse SALARM for 1 s (S22 p.7.33); factory default OUT101 := HALARM OR SALARM (S22 Table 4.83) closes the alarm contact, and SER4 := SALARM (S22 Table 4.122) records it in the SER. One attempt per session; no further ACC after a failure. Sent only by the transport auth phase. If the Level 1 password is disabled, ACC goes straight to '=>' with no prompt (S22 p.7.33); the adapter sends the password only after seeing 'Password: ?', otherwise the password would be executed as a command and logged (D26, raised by A6).

commands.citation: S22 Table 7.59 p.7.73 (Access Level 0)
commands.notes: Sent at end of every session.
commands.side_effects: Returns to Level 0. Without QUIT a Telnet session stays at its elevated level until TIDLE expires (S22 p.7.15-7.16 Telnet Server note).

commands.citation: S22 Table 7.43 and Figure 7.38 p.7.64; Figure 3.20 p.3.14
commands.notes: Fields FID, BFID, CID, DEVID, DEVCODE, PARTNO, CONFIG, SPECIAL, display package lines, and on IEC 61850 models iedName/type/configVersion. Per-line checksum = 4-hex sum of characters of '"KEY=value",' (verified on all 10 lines of Figure 7.38).
commands.side_effects: None documented. Occupies the session for the response.

commands.citation: S22 Table 7.63 p.7.75 ('Displays a chronological progression of all available SER rows (as many as 1024 rows). Row 1 is the most recently triggered row'); Figure 10.16 p.10.40
commands.notes: On SEL-751 bare SER returns all rows (unlike A4's report for SEL-400 series). Row/date range forms exist (Table 7.63) but stay denied until needed.
commands.side_effects: None documented. Returns up to the full ring buffer (1,024 rows on SEL-751, S4), so every read repeats rows already collected.

commands.citation: S22 Table 7.67 p.7.77 ('SHO G s Shows global settings', Access Level 1); S22 Table 4.90 p.4.230 (UTC_OFF, DST_BEGM..DST_ENDH, DATE_F)
commands.side_effects: None documented. Output contains configuration values; store as sensitive evidence.
commands.notes: APPROVED by A1 2026-10-23 as this exact line, with no setting-name argument s. Needed to state UTC offset and DST rule for SER local times. Output is sensitive configuration evidence. No password-bearing setting appears in any S22 settings sheet (A2 searched every ':=' line for pass/pwd/key/secret/community/auth: none); passwords are set only with PAS (Table 7.52) and are not settings. S22 prints no example SHO G output.

commands.citation: S22 Table 7.67 p.7.77 ('SHO P n s Shows serial port settings. n specifies the port', Access Level 1); Port 1 is Ethernet per S22 Table 7.1 p.7.1; Port 1 settings sheet (ETELNET, MAXACC, LANG, TPORT, TCBAN, TIDLE, FASTOP, EFTPSERV, FTPACC, FTPUSER, HTTPACC)
commands.side_effects: None documented. Output contains addresses and FTPUSER; store as sensitive evidence.
commands.notes: APPROVED by A1 2026-10-23 as this exact line, with no setting-name argument s. The port number is always explicit (bare SHO P shows the active port). Lets the collector record MAXACC, FASTOP, LANG, FTPACC and HTTPACC before collecting; per A1, MAXACC above 1 is recorded and warned, not refused (owner decision pending). Output includes IP addresses and FTPUSER (a user name, not a password); no password-bearing setting exists in the Port 1 sheet. A1 asked for Table 2.5 as the Port 1 citation, but S22 Table 2.5 covers the Port 4 communications card; Table 7.1 is the correct citation.
